thesis: VTRS is a modest-conviction pullback long in an established uptrend. Price sits above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200 after a post-earnings rerating, and the 4-session pullback gives a defined entry near 20.05-20.40 with a stop at 19.70 and a 1.9 reward/risk to the 21.20 high. Valuation is cheap on absolute multiples and free cash flow is large relative to cash, so dilution risk is low. Pharma is a defensive-adjacent name in a risk-off tape that is punishing tech, which helps relative resilience, though the regime card does not list the sector as leading. The case is limited: revenue growth has faded to flat, volume on the down days is a mild distribution signal, and the 21.20 target is close to the analyst mean, so this is a small, disciplined tactical position and not a high-conviction one.
